comm_messages.content: [Incumbent defense] Over the past two election cycles as manager, I consistently contributed 10 tokens each round, balancing personal gain with group benefit, which helped maintain a stable public pool and steady returns for all. My record shows reliability and cooperation, and I will continue to promote fair contributions if re-elected.

[Campaign speech] I will be a fair and transparent manager who uses rewards to encourage cooperation and targeted punishments only when necessary to deter free‑riding. My goal is to maximize the group's total earnings while ensuring that contributors are recognized and that the public good remains strong.

[Campaign speech] If elected manager, I will use my reward and punishment powers to promote cooperation: I'll reward those who contribute at least half their endowment, and I'll punish those who contribute nothing or very little, ensuring that free-riding is costly and generosity is recognized. My goal is to raise the average contribution, which increases the public good and benefits everyone, including myself.

[Campaign speech] I will be a fair and strategic manager, using my reward budget to encourage consistent contributors and my punishment budget sparingly to deter free-riding only when it threatens group cooperation. My goal is to maximize the group's total earnings while ensuring that those who contribute are recognized and those who undermine the public good face consequences. I will allocate rewards and punishments based on observed behavior each round, aiming to sustain high contributions over the remaining rounds.

[Campaign speech] As manager, I will prioritize fairness and cooperation: I will reward those who contribute at least 12 tokens each round, encouraging strong participation, and I will punish only those who contribute less than 4 tokens, targeting clear free‑riders. My goal is to boost the public pool while keeping earnings balanced for all.

[Campaign speech] I will be a fair and balanced manager, using rewards to encourage cooperation and measured punishment only against persistent free-riders to protect the group's earnings. My goal is to maximize overall payoffs by fostering trust and accountability, not to exert power for its own sake.
